description: Change tag. NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE = a GDS re-save with no business change (noise). SCHEDULE_CHANGE = airline-initiated re-protection (old flight HX/UN replaced by a confirmed flight on the same route and day within 60 min). NEW_TRIP = first version of a booking.
Number of booking versions carrying this tag. A version can carry several tags, so do not sum across tags to count versions.
True when the version changed something that matters (anything other than NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE / STALE_VERSION). Use this to count significant vs noise versions.
Number of airline schedule changes detected in this version (usually 0 or 1).
Array of change tags for this version; use array_contains(tags, 'SCHEDULE_CHANGE') to filter.
Segment status code: HK/KK/TK confirmed, HX/UN cancelled or unable.

question: What share of booking versions were significant vs noise?
sql: SELECT date(gold_version_changes.ingested_at) AS day, count(*) AS versions, sum(CASE WHEN gold_version_changes.is_significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS significant, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN gold_version_changes.is_significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) AS significant_pct FROM users.rohit_bhagwat.gold_version_changes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

question: Which carriers had the most schedule changes?
sql: SELECT gold_version_changes.carrier, sum(gold_version_changes.schedule_change_count) AS schedule_changes FROM users.rohit_bhagwat.gold_version_changes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
